title: Zesty Peruvian Prawns Ceviche
description: A refreshing and protein-rich Peruvian dish featuring raw frozen prawns, perfect for a post-workout snack. This paleo-friendly recipe combines the flavors of citrus, ginger, and aji amarillo peppers.
instructions: Thaw the frozen prawns according to package instructions and peel them.
In a blender or food processor, combine lime juice, grapefruit juice, ginger, and aji amarillo peppers and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the prawns, blended juice mixture, red onion, and cilantro.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Before serving, give the mixture a good stir and adjust the seasoning if necessary.
Serve the ceviche in small glasses or cups and garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
This dish is best consumed immediately, but it can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
